# Pidgeon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040)</sub>
- **Role:** schoolmaster  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P40](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0040), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Teddy Pidgeon  <sub>[v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

He continuously twirls his mustache.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)_

## Personality

He maintains poor discipline in his classroom and is prone to sarcastic or overbearing behavior when punishing students. He is lenient, emotional, and shows strong romantic interest toward his older female students.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065), [v1 c15 P83](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0083), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## Traits

- sarcastic  <sub>[v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P65](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0065)</sub>
- lenient  <sub>[v1 c19 P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032)</sub>

## Abilities

- reciting theatrical addresses  <sub>[v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039)</sub>
- writing poetry  <sub>[v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068)</sub>

## Goals

- prepare older students for the Regent's Academy entrance exam  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091)</sub>

## History

Mr. Pidgeon served as the schoolmaster at Brierley school. During his tenure, he spent much of his effort instructing the older pupils preparing for the Regent's examination while neglecting the younger ones. He frequently courted Sukey Pullen, spending classroom time sitting by her bench, writing poems, and visiting her home in the evenings. During one lesson, he punished Nell Harcourt by forcing her to stand by the blackboard after she broke her slate over Hugh Carrow's head, and on the following day he ordered her to sit next to Hugh for being late. After Nell stopped attending school for a time, she eventually returned, and Mr. Pidgeon later commended her rapid academic progress to Obed Abernethy. At a school concert, he delivered Mark Antony's address while gazing at Sukey Pullen. At the end of June, his term at Brierley school concluded, and he gave a tearful farewell address to the students before departing.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P61](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0061), [v1 c15 P68](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0068), [v1 c15 P91](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0091), [v1 c18 P6](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0006), [v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c19 P39](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0039), [v1 c21 P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_
